entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: Where is the phantom thief's body?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Phantom thief? Body?

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: This isn't the time for games!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Um, I really don't know what you're[n]speaking of...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Oh, but that reminds me...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I received a calling card from the Phantom[n]Thieves... but everything from then on is[n]a blur...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: No... Could I have done something[n]wrong!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Then, I... I...

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: Hey!?

entries.speaker: Junior Detective
entries.en: Did the Phantom Thieves get to her?

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: Don't tell me, was your heart... Could this[n]be true, Niijima!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What have I done?

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: The phantom thief! He's alive!

entries.speaker: Junior Detective
entries.en: Even so, how did he escape from the[n]station?

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: It doesn't matter! We must catch him!

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: We can't let this get out! Not only was[n]the suicide announcement false, but[n]he got away on top of that!

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: We'll have to interrogate you... as a key[n]witness.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why me?

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: Check the documents you created.

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: You may remember something once you[n]look at them.

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: ...But even if you can't recall, all[n]responsibility for his escape rests[n]squarely on your shoulders.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm sorry, I honestly don't know what's[n]going on here...

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: You're the last person to talk to that[n]phantom thief!

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: You have to clean up your boss's mess![n]If you're going to resent someone,[n]resent your dead director!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Is illness really what killed him?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Do you think his death was truly due to[n]illness!?

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: That doesn't matter!

entries.speaker: Police Detective
entries.en: Your actions have made a mockery of[n]the police force! You're going to pay[n]for this, I promise!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Very well.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's all up to you now, everyone.
